name: Entry & Loop
description: Application bootstrap that initializes GLFW, loads GLAD, constructs the Game object, and drives the per-frame update/render loop

name: Game Logic
description: Core tower-defense state machine, unit placement, combat, economy, and enemy wave-spawning schedule for the Iron Man vs Doctor Doom game

name: UI & Presentation
description: Player-facing visuals: hero card-bar HUD, all menu screens, animated battlefield grid, switchable backgrounds, and the scripted 18-second intro cutscene

name: Rendering Engine
description: OpenGL 3.3 batched sprite renderer, pixel-font drawing, VAO/VBO management, sprite-frame GPU upload, and embedded ASCII-art pixel palettes for all hero and enemy units

name: Audio
description: miniaudio-based audio subsystem providing background music, sound effects, and hero/enemy voice-line playback

name: Data & Config
description: Shared game constants (lane count, board bounds, coin values, physics), unit-type enums, and geometry helper functions for all six character types

name: External Libraries
description: Vendored third-party headers and sources: GLAD v2 OpenGL function loader, legacy GLAD v1 source kept for compatibility, GLFW 3.5.1 windowing/input API, and Khronos platform type aliases

name: Build & Documentation
description: Visual Studio solution and project files that configure the C++17/x64 build, plus project documentation covering features, audit findings, progress tracking, and LinkedIn notes
